prompt: Use $apple-hig to help with this task: Repair invitation and access states in an iPad shared writing project. Read interface.md. Edit interface.md in place to implement a concrete revised specification. Write result.md with decisions, a worked before/after, acceptance checks, and evidence limits. Your patch to interface.md is required; summarize its changes in result.md.

input_files.interface.md: Platform: iPadOS/macOS. Share link silently grants edit access to anyone, viewers can trigger destructive edits, pending invitees appear as active collaborators and revocation leaves the UI claiming access forever. Offline edits may conflict.

criteria.task_completion: Patch explicit permission scope, pending/accepted/revoked states, role-respecting actions and a recoverable conflict explanation; distinguish sending a copy from collaborating on shared content.
criteria.hig_correctness: Apply the collaboration-and-sharing guidance to the actual supplied decisions, preserving its platform and contextual qualifications.
criteria.artifact_usefulness: Provide implementable states, labels, transitions or layout decisions for this specific fixture, with a concrete before/after and observable checks. Patch explicit permission scope, pending/accepted/revoked states, role-respecting actions and a recoverable conflict explanation; distinguish sending a copy from collaborating on shared content.
criteria.conditions_accessibility: Retain the stated platform/input constraints. Address accessible alternatives and exceptional states relevant to this task. Patch explicit permission scope, pending/accepted/revoked states, role-respecting actions and a recoverable conflict explanation; distinguish sending a copy from collaborating on shared content.
criteria.evidence_honesty: Distinguish source-backed guidance, product assumptions and proposed checks. Do not invent device, SDK, accessibility, visual, performance or user-test results.

critical_errors: Invents observations or claims Apple-device execution absent supplied evidence.
Recommends a topic-specific behavior contrary to the supplied source without explaining the scope and tradeoff.
